name: Adaptive Coordinate Conversion
definition: A technique used by Lim et al. to visualize 3D ultrasound datasets, where points within the native pyramidal ultrasound coordinate system were adaptively converted on the fly to a Cartesian grid.
summary: Adaptive Coordinate Conversion dynamically maps 3D ultrasound data from pyramidal to Cartesian grids via direct one-to-one ring correspondence, enabling real-time GPU rendering without pre-interpolation.
